L23: 
L24: Enhanced airports pack from Argentina. I just make them playable, adding missing runways, taxiways, aprons, lights, removing forests and adjusting imperfections from the default airports in MSFS 2020.
L25: Please do note that I am not a 3D artist hence I dont replicate the buildings, just search on the library for the most similar ones. Please dont complain about that, there are other artists improving Argentina, if they make a better one just go for it :-)
L26: Aereal: Some airports have outdated maps images, this means that I need to add an updated one, hence the larger file. The airport will still work without it if you need to free up disk space.

L42: YPKG, Kalgoorlie-Boulder – WA, Australia
L43: Kalgoorlie-Boulder Airport is an airport in Kalgoorlie. Western Australia.
L44: The airport is a major hub for fly-in-fly-out service due to the mining boom in the region. It is also a hub for the Goldfields Air Services, which offers chartering and flight lessons, along with the Royal Flying Doctors Service, which uses Kalgoorlie as a hub due to the lack of medical assistance for people in the region, transporting major injuries from Kalgoorlie to Perth.

L48: 33 Custom Buildings and Signs and other assets

L23: 
L24: There have been reports that some of the airfields have been surrounded by trees (maybe due to serious global warming) in FS2024, but it seems that it have been fixed after SU3.
L25: 
L26: It is quite a surprising fact that there are flights to Antarctica using ordinary airliner, so I tried to get the informations of airfields in Antarctica. In the recent version, there are 20 airfields have been added:
L27:   * Boulder Clay Runway (AQBC)
L28:   * Concordia (AT03)
L29:   * D85 Skiway (AT05)
L30:   * Fossil Bluff Skiway (AT10)
L31:   * Kohnen Station Skiway (AT12)
L32:   * Mid Point Skiway (AT14)
L33:   * Molodezhnaya (AT15)
L34:   * Neumayer Station Skiway (AT16)
L35:   * Novolazarevskaya (AT17)
L36:   * Odell Glacier (AT18)
L37:   * Sanae IV Skiway (AT22)
L38:   * Sky Blu (AT24)
L39:   * Troll (AT27/ENOE)+#
L40:   * Vostok Station Skiway (AT28)
L41:   * Halley Station Skiway (EGAH)
L42:   * Phoenix Field (NZFX)+#
L43:   * Union Glacier Runway (SCGC)
L44:   * Wolf's Fang Runway (AT98/WICE)+#
L45:   * O'Higgins Skiway (SCBO)*
L46:   * Wilkins Runway (YWKS)+#
L47: Those airfields with (*) are built on sea ice. From the results of test flights, you can't start a flight from these airfields as aircraft will sink into water, or immediately end up in a crash. On the other hand, you must see that sea ice has been built up on the area for landing. As there are no reference about the landscape near the airfields, landing at night is dangerous especially during winter, where wind speed equivalent to a hurricane is usual.
L48: Why there is no South Pole Station Airfield (NZSP)? The answer is not that straight forward. Most of the web mapping providers adapt the WGS 84/Pseudo-Mercator (EPSG:3857) as the projection standard, which the highest latitude supported is 85.05° north/south. Terrain beyond this latitude could not be rendered properly. In fact I've tried different methods to place the runway near the Geographic South Pole, but it failed to give anything meaningful, and only something erroneous as the result.
L49: However, I've placed a POI on it, so you can still try to fly there.
L50: The snow groomers at the airports are from the cite18†Winter Asset Pack by Usatix , cite18†download this library here otherwise they will not show up.
L51: 
L52: True bearings (sometimes Grid bearings) should be used for navigation, as magvar over the continent varies a lot even for a short distance, and the value could even be as much as 180 degrees if you're flying somewhere between the Magnetic South Pole and Geographic South Pole.
L53: Among these airfields, Wilkins Runway (YWKS), Troll Airfield (AT27/ENOE) and Wolf's Fang Runway (AT98/WICE) have published RNAV Approach or SID, see the links below for charts:
L54: 
L55: YWKS:
L56: cite19†https://www.airservicesaustralia.com/aip/aip.asp?pg=10 (Choose "Departure and Approach Procedures")†www.airservicesaustralia.com L57: AT27/ENOE:
L58: cite20†https://www.pansops.no/charting/ (2016 version by Norwegian Polar Institute)†www.pansops.no L59: cite21†https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sb7MyT039AI (2023 version by Norse Atlantic Airways)†www.youtube.com L60: 
L61: AT98/WICE:
L62: cite22†https://wolfsfangrunway.com/media/uploads/info/71747-006-WFR_WFANG_1A_RWY_17T-Chart-V2.1.pdf†wolfsfangrunway.com L63: cite23†https://wolfsfangrunway.com/media/uploads/info/71747-003-WFR_RNP_RWY_17-Chart_V2.1.pdf†wolfsfangrunway.com L64: 
L65: Instrument procedures for Phoenix Field
L66: The instrument procedures for Phoenix Field are partly implemented, with thanks to an undisclosed player. 3 SIDs and only one STAR have been coded where the coordinates of all the associated waypoints are known or built-in. On the other hand, 3 instrument approaches for Runway 33 (TACAN/TLS/RNAV) and 2 for Runway 15 (TACAN/RNAV) have been coded, with some waypoints could be calculated with good precision.
L67: Those TACAN approaches have been coded as VOR approaches as there is not much non-military aircraft which can receive TACAN signals, while the TLS approach has been coded as Localizer approaches. From the results of test flights, the radio navaids works somehow erratic, which may caused by the very great local magvar of the area, or Grid headings have been applied as per documents. All the vertical glideslope of the approaches are -2.5 degrees except TLS and RNAV Runway 33 with the standard -3.0 degrees.
L68: For Runway 33 TACAN approach,  track VORTAC "ZFX" radial 322, while it is 151 for Runway 15 TACAN approach.
L69: Helper NDBs
L70: 
L71: For airfields with jets operating on them but no published instrument approach is known, I've added some fictional "helper" NDBs to facilitate better navigation and approaches. (You can't imagine something bulky like VOR or ILS antenna to be installed on Antarctica) Here is the list (more will be added later):
L72: 
L73:   * SCGC - "UGL" / 360kHz
L74:   * AT17 - "NV" / 280kHz
L75:   * AQBC - "BC" / 340Hz
L76: 
L77: Ground handlings
L78: There are 4 airports (marked by #) with apron being explicitly defined, with parking bay assigned. Only Phoenix Field and Troll Airport have refuelling available.
L79: 
L80: I have also made the cite24†livery of Skytraders for A230neo , although they use A319 in real life.
L81: 
L82: To look for the missing airstrips on the other side of the Earth, you may have interest for the cite25†Arctic Airstrip Bunble by me.

L23: This is only usable by deleting the Asobo version
L24: so I don't think this will be of much use to anyone any more after the UK update. I reckon I did a better job landside but who gives a toss? This version is now primarily for historians and people running out of space.
L25: Only been to Liverpool twice myself. Once for twenty minutes with a lass who only wanted to see the Cavern Club, the cabbie looked like he wanted to die when she said that, and to fly out to the Isle of Man for the TT as it was the only route that didn't cost a million quid. A fine airport indeed.
L26: All ground textures and markings have been stripped and replaced. Many buildings have been erased and replaced. Others have had better buildings rammed into their innards. The control tower is an, erm, unusual concoction but it is at least the correct height. The flying school up the end has been fleshed out. Loads of bits have been detailed.
L27: I've tried to match reality wherever possible but obviously there are limitations with the standard buildings.
L28: Since there is no yellow submarine available I have chosen to install an elephant driving a speed boat. Some may ask what that symbolises. This is for each of us to find out for ourselves.
L29: For some reason many sites that I get to work on become heavily distorted when loaded in the editor and then loaded in the sim when done. Everything landside on this one had to be reflattened even though it's flat as standard. It's OK for me but if this mangles any parts of the airport for you let me know. I'll be very sad if it does.
L30: The original taxi system has been kept and in places this makes for some cheesy ground markings. Theirs, not mine.
L31: 
L32: V 1.2
L33: 
L34: Probably not of interest to most people as they're using the Asobo version, but I realised I was hardly flying here so would rather not have a pointless gigabyte used up and gave this a quick going over to replace it.
L35: 
L36: This recompiles it, adds a few thingies from my airport asset library and removes some irrelevant ground textures to make the package smaller.
L37: The second download is the Piddly Edition with no ground textures which makes it only a couple of hundred kilobytes for those who are truly mean with their storage space.

L24: Update V1.3.1
L25: 
L26: Silly me, I only fixed the left side PAPI lights in the last update. Now the left and right PAPI lights for runways 18-36 are 4 degrees for the glide slope.
L27: 
L28: Update V1.3
L29: PAPI lights have a glideslope of 4.0 degrees for runways 18 and 36 based on approach charts I found (previously were incorrectly set to 3.0 degrees). "RWY AHEAD" hold short markings are now less opaque and were resized a bit smaller to make them a little more realistic and blend better.
L30: Update V1.2:
L31: Hold short markings no longer show " 36-18" and now say "RWY AHEAD" as they do in reality.
L32: 
L33: Update V1.1:
L34: Taxiways to gates now have gate numbers. I had to hand draw them with the default paint lines so I hope they are acceptable. No other major changes, just a few more vehicles around the tarmac and some plastic red and white barriers on the south end of the runway over the tunnel.
L35: 
L36: Description:
L37: I have tried to recreate Tromso with better scenery and the airport has been flattened for a smoother takeoff and landing. It's not perfect and I will continue updating it, but now you should be able to enjoy it a little more :)
L38: Taxiways have been properly labeled and signed but the ATC still won't use them to direct you unfortunately. Default buildings have been left but the jetways and parking are improved (this elimates the aircraft sitting in the middle of taxiway yankee between delta and echo). The runways are labeled as 18-36 as this was recently changed from 01-19 in late 2020. The approaches/departures are still the default and ILS works.
L39: The PAPI lights are set to 3 degrees but after a test, ILS approaches to runway 18 seem a bit steeper, probably because of the terrain to the north. I will adjust these and any comments/critique are appreciated!
L40: Check out my partly realistic/fictional version of Svalbard too! I created both so I could enjoy some direct flights between the two.
L41: Installation: Drag and drop into community folder.
L42: 
L43: If you would like to support my work, I appreciate it! If you can't, that's okay too :)

L23: Ljubljana Jože Pučnik Airport (Letališče Jožeta Pučnika Ljubljana) is the largest international airport in Slovenia. It is located about 20km north of the capital city. The airport is surrounded by hills It was the main hub of the now non-existing slovenian airline Adria airways. I don't want to brag but I worked there :D.
L24: I made this airport because the original that FS2020 ships with is not as nice as I expected it to be. Mostly due to parking spots, there being bumps everywhere and straight up grass holes in taxiways. The airport is NOT COMPLETE. I made this version in december 2020 but didn't update it because of exams. I didn't upload it because I didn't know this site existed. I am happy with the upgrade I made. If you're not you can express your oppinion in the comments :)
L25: Airport info:
L26: -Runway 30/12 3300m/45m
L27: -Elevation 390m / 1300ft
L28: Instalation:
L29: -Drag and drop into your community folder.
L30: Future plans:
L31: -Modeled buildings
L32: -Plowed aprons in the winter
L33: -Removing marshallers from parking that doesn't need them
L34: -Paving the roads outside and inside the airport
L35: ---------------------------------------------------------
L36: There will soon be a payware version of this airport released so I will stop working on this. I made this addon for myself but shared it because why not make a few more people happy :D. Since I can soon buy a much sexier, completed version of this airport I see no point in continuing on this. Maybe if im in a good mood I'll model the new terminal and hangar next to the main terminal for you guys so the main area of the airport looks nice but don't count on it.
L37: If there are any problems DM me or comment below and I'll fix them.
L38: 
L39: Hope you have a nice time with this mod :D

L220: You probably have two sceneries in your Community folder causing conflicts. Hopefully the info below will allow you to solve the problem.
L221: 1- When MSFS starts, it loads all its own files first, then it reads the layout.json file of everything in the Community folder in alphabetical order and “stacks” those layouts on top of each other. If ever two packages have files with exactly the same name in exactly the same path whichever one (or ones) was loaded later does not get its own copy – it gets the other package’s copy (the first one loaded), creating conflicts and the airport doesn't appear as it should or it creates a crash to desktop.
L222: Potential Solution:
L223: 1) • Addons conflicting with each other: Try to temporarily move all other addons out of your Community folder, then delete your SceneryIndexes folder as described in #3) below and test if the addon is displayed correctly. If so, another addon is causing this. To find the conflict, slowly move them back into your Community folder one by one and each time test if the addon is working. Ask the developers of the conflicting sceneries to modify the sceneries that are conflicting.
L224: Then do not put the conflicting folders in your community folder together for your flight.
L225: 3) Deleting the SceneryIndexes folder. Depending on your platform, delete the following folder:
L226: • Microsoft Store version: C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\Packages\Microsoft.FlightSimulator_8wekyb3d8bbwe\LocalCache\SceneryIndexes
L227: • Steam version: C:\Users\username\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft Flight Simulator\SceneryIndexes

L25: 
L26: The airport is the main gateway to the Puerto Princesa Underground River, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the New 7 Wonders of Nature.

L24: This scenery enhances Shimojishima Airport, which was added in WU1.
L25: Requires WU1 to be installed.
L26:

L28: Added aerial imagery.

L27: #### CYRIL E. KING AIRPORT UPDATED SCENERY PROJECT
L28: 
L29:  [UPDATED AS NEW INFO IS DISCOVERED] ATTENTION!
L30: 
L31: IF YOU NO LONGER HAVE CRASH-TO-DESTOP ERRORS WHEN YOU LOAD MY SCENERY SINCE ALL THE RECENT SIM UPDATES, PLEASE LET ME KNOW. I PREVIOUSLY UPLOADED A 'LITE VERSION' AT THE FOLLOWING LINK BELOW SOME TIME IN 2021 TO CORRECT THAT, HOWEVER IT IS NOT UPDATED TO V1.5 AND I WOULD LIKE TO REMOVE IT:
L32: 
L33: https://flightsim.to/file/17288/cyril-e-king-airport-tist-updated-scenery-project-lite-version
L34: COPY AND PASTE THE LINK INTO YOUR BROWSER IF YOU STILL ENCOUNTER THE ERRORS UPON LOADING AND TELL ME IF YOU STILL WANT IT UPDATED AS WELL. THANK YOU.
L35: 
L36: 
L37: 
L38: Also, check out this video link of the airport in action by 'Finite Flying':
L39: 
L40: https://youtu.be/g3asTJgX1r8
L41: 
L42: 
L43: 
L44: 
L45: 
L46: DEPENDENCIES:
L47: NEW LIGHTING EFFECTS AND ITEMS ADDED: In order to see some of the new lighting effects, additional sail boats and some 3d people used in this scenery, you will need to download and save in your community folder some required files. Check "Dependencies" section for link to download.
L48: 
L49: 
L50: 
L51: DESCRIPTION:
L52:                                 The Cyril E. King Airport is the largest international airport in the U.S. Virgin Islands and one of the busiest hubs in the eastern Caribbean. The Airport is a public airport located at No. 70 Lindbergh Bay on the southwestern side of St. Thomas, U.S. Virgin Islands - approximately four miles east of the capital city, Charlotte Amalie.  South-West of Beef Island, Tortola and North of St. Criox. It's one of the busiest airports in the eastern Caribbean.
L53: Many direct flights are available for international travelers arriving from the U.S., with non-stop service to St. Thomas from Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dulles, Fort Lauderdale, Miami, Newark, and New York. It was known as Harry S Truman Airport until 1984, when it was renamed to honor Cyril Emmanuel King, the second elected governor of the U.S. Virgin Islands. A new airport opened in November 1990 and retained the name.
L54:                                This is my first US based airport i've done, so obviously there were some differences to this than with previous airports while constructing and putting this scenery together. I put most of the effort in the layer of ground texturing and the variety of object details especially for the main terminal parking area as much as I could to make this look at least 90% accurate.
L55:                                 While almost completing this, I learned there was a payware version to this out. If I had knew about it before, I wouldn't have taken up the task of doing this, but I continued on anyways since I reached that far. I do hope you will enjoy regardless!
L56: 
L57: 
L58: 
L59: 
L60: 
L61:  INSTALLATION:
L62: Open and extract ''lexpro-St Thomas_updated_scenery_project_v1.0'' (or the version name you choose to download) to your prefered location on your PC, then unZip and open the folder and copy  "Cyril_E_King_Updated_Scenery_Project" folder into where your Community folder is located, then start the sim and go to TIST - Cyril E. King Airport. That's it!
L63: Each time I upload an updated version here, just replace the same "Cyril_E_King_Updated_Scenery_Project"  folder in your Community folder to update the scenery. Make back ups to the old folders if necessary.
L64: 
L65: 
L66: 
L67: DETAILED UPDATED FEATURES TO DEFAULT SCENERY (V1.0) - TIST:
L68:   * - Started from scratch and deleted everything except the default terminal building and a few surrounding buildings.
L69:   * - Stratigically placed very specific scenery objects from the sim library around the default building to try match the design structure IRL.
L70:   * - Made some corrections to the surrounding terrain and elevation of the Airport. A bit challenging but managable in the end.
L71:   * -  Added runway/lights, PAPI lights, aprons, taxi lights [despite the fact that by default they were already there, editing the elevation made them dissapear, so I had to replace them again :\ ], taxi ways, taxiway signs,[A few might not be too accurate] ''wear n' tear'' textures, ground markings and a couple dark painted color lines exactly like IRL.
L72:   * - Edited airport taxiway data so ATC properly directs you to and from your parking location.
L73:   * Added and created heavily detailed 'wear n' tear' and layered textures to main apron of terminal building as well as some extra layered textures to taxiways to give a more 'used' feel.
L74:   * Recreated all 'Hold short' numbering designs and markings as well as 90% of the runway markings with layered 'wear n' tear' textures.
L75:   * - Corrected location of Windsocks
L76:   * - Edited service vehicle data so they drive on the designated roads they are to drive on and not all over the taxiways and runway. [I cannot stop them from parking in your parking space as the creators pre-programed them by default to do so. I can only re-rout their way]
L77:   * - Added a light above the Windsocks
L78:   * Added 4 anntenas with red beacons on the Northern moutainside of the island.
L79:   * -Added a small circular stone structure design around the base of one windsock like IRL
L80:   * - Added the control tower with a beacon light.
L81:   * - Replaced a few default buildings with some from the library to keep up to date with whats there presently
L82:   * - Added Airport lights around the airport.
L83:   * -  Added extra lighting under the Airport terminal roofing that was added. Also added lighting to any surrounding buildings in the area including the firestation building which I replaced with a generic building and other buildings add. Also lighting on a few boats, yachts and a cruiseship. [Remember to check Dependencies for required files to see them]
L84:   * - Added static aircraft\service vehicles with some animated Marshalls\Workers surrounding them.
L85:   * - Randomly placed Marshalls/Workers and other animated people around the Airport in general. [Some of these are additional 3d people. Again, check Dependencies section to see them]
L86:   * - Added barbwire fencing around parts of the Airport like IRL. Also added additional fencing in certain areas within the airport.
L87:   * - Added many vehicles in the area including the main parking lot [work in progress]. Also added some animated vehicles on the road.
L88:   * - Added and placed a lot of stones to simulate the stone structure design in front of Runway 10 like IRL - corrected 1 or 2 beach areas surrounding the airport.
L89:   * - Added many more trees/plants/grass, auto-gen trees in general areas close to and surrounding the Airport.
L90:   * - Added lots of boats, yachts and ferries in the surrounding area like IRL. [Some of these are new files added. Again, check Dependencies section to see them]
L91:   * - Recreated and added the wall thats behind the main terminal building leading to the cargo section.
L92:   * - Added a small red and white checkered building with antennas near by with a red light on the large one close to Runway 10 like IRL
L93:   * - Added many other scattered scenery objects around the airport in general.
L94: 
L95: Thats all for now. More to come in every version update. Do enjoy this on going project which takes a great deal of time and effort. Feel free to leave any comments after you've flown around. Have fun flying and see you in the Sim world :)

L296: # Cyril E. King Airport (TIST) Updated Scenery Project v1.5
L297: The Cyril E. King Airport is the largest international airport in the U.S. Virgin Islands and one of the busiest hubs in the eastern Caribbean. The Airport is a public airport located at No. 70 Lindbergh Bay on the southwestern side of St. Thomas, U.S. Virgin Islands - approximately four miles east of the capital city, Charlotte Amalie.  South-West of Beef Island, Tortola and North of St. Criox. It's one of the busiest airports in the eastern Caribbean.
L298: Many direct flights are available for international travelers arriving from the U.S., with non-stop service to St. Thomas from Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dulles, Fort Lauderdale, Miami, Newark, and New York. It was known as Harry S Truman Airport until 1984, when it was renamed to honor Cyril Emmanuel King, the second elected governor of the U.S. Virgin Islands. A new airport opened in November 1990 and retained the name.

L360: [Since Sim update 5, my Sim was literally broken and couldn't create any more scenery mods. Some scenery objects that were used also got changed without warning after the updates. Thankfully many Sim updates later, i'm now able to create again. Thanks for your patience :) ] - Replaced back all taxiway lights. They now light back up again at night. - Upgraded entire main apron taxi markings for all gate parking like IRL.
L361: (Note: Some markings may not be totally accurate in arrangement, so I had to improvise as there is a minimum size limit to the gate parking in the sim in order see the stairs and baggage carts for large aircrafts (A320, B777), making the space less to work with.
L362: Each parking space has to be a diameter of 19 and above, otherwise you will only get the ground unit truck and the small pushback guy only) - Made some adjustments to the parking spots data and upgraded all gates to a larger space to accommodate large aircraft. - Added some more static vehicles in the area. - Added one extra parking space gate that was inadvertently omitted in the first release. Because of where its situated, it's not enough space to put a large gate.
L363: So it will only be for medium to small aircraft parking. - Changed all airport lighting and main terminal lighting to a warm color type as they are IRL. [I prefer the cold type to be honest :) ] -Added an extra roof overhang to the main terminal building close to the South-West side that was inadvertently omitted in the first release. - Added flashing runway end lights at the end of runway 10 like IRL.
L364: - Made some terra-forming adjusts to the right side at the end of runway 28 where a hill is supposed to be. - Added some large tanks on the right side hill slope of runway 28. - Added a Localizer antenna and a small red checkered building at the end of runway 28. - Added a few more street lights and extended the street along side and beyond runway 28. - Applied a stoney-like texture on the south end of the rocky/stoney area beyond the cargo section to give a little more detail.

L26: 
L27: Upgrade Airport scenery for VRMM Velana International Airport, Male, Hulhule Island, Maldives.
L28: 
L29: This Upgraded scenery was requested. Based on images & online information.
L30: 
L31: Still lots of improvements possible on this scenery, but very useable so releasing now for all to enjoy.
L32: Some artistic licence has been used plus a little imagination, so some inaccuracies do exist.
L33: A big task this one, as the ground images are very poor & elevation at sea level. The ground has been elevated correctly. The sea area has been changed to appear as in real life. Ground textures improved & buildings/models added.  All runways, taxiways etc replaced & remade. Boats, Yachts & other vessels added, with some being dynamic. Some gates created so services for some are available, jetways move into place, catering, baggage handling, Fuel truck, pushback etc.
L34: Parking Ramp & Gate list will be added here asap.
L35: ATC for both VRMM & VRSB is operating....
L36: NOTE : The Seaplane base has been created but another scenery file is needed to make this work correctly see link.
L37: (cite23†VRSB Male Seaplane Base ). Remove or overwwrite old version of VRSB. Version 2.0 + required.
L38: 
L39: Buildings are generic so please dont expect a perfect replica of the real airport, just a reasonable representation.
L40: Nearby islands also have had improvement & some texture changes.
L41: Note - You will need the Free librarys within game to see all objects. Start the sim & Go to marketplace from main screen,
L42: Select full catalogue & click on free. You should see the librarys needed. Vessels Core Library, UK2000 Common Library,  EDLP Paderborn-Lippstad Airport.   See screenshot image.

L45: 
L46: Navigation Location    4.192936, 73.529025
L47: 
L48: All original msfs models etc used.
L49: Installation - After unzipping, place the complete "sac-airport-vrmm-male" folder
L50: into your MSFS community folder.
L51: 
L52: Thats it, Enjoy.

Grantley Adams International Airport (GAIA) (IATA: BGI, ICAO: TBPB) is the international airport of Barbados, located in Seawell, Christ Church. It is the only designated port of entry for persons arriving and departing by air in Barbados and operates as one of the major gateways to the Eastern Caribbean.

L23: 
L24: #### AFRICA TO GO!
L25: is a joint project that aims to visually upgrade AI airports, airfields, bush strips and heliports across the continent and combine them into a continuously expanding mod. The current changelog lists who contributed which scenery.
L26: #### Not all of these are not exact 3D replicas, instead an attempt has been made to visually upgrade the orphaned AI airfields in a similar way based on all World & City Updates.
L27: You need essential libraries (check the dependencies before asking for missing objects!) and make sure to download the free ESD and UK2000Scenery from the Marketplace.
L28: Some projects now also have customized buildings, take a look at the screenshots.
L29: #### NOTAM
L30: New: Download includes a folder for the changelog and screenshots from new projects.
L31: New since v2.0: Downtown night enhancements (©Laca1988)
L32: Check the Changelog for information on updates.
L33: A Google Map with all published airfields can be found here cite31†>>> Go to Google Map†www.google.com L34: 
L35: #### You can expect quite different quality depending on the state of the AI Airfield, but where we could, we modified the following
L36: #### Optimized ground textures (based on Bing & Google Maps)
L37: Recent airfield layouts incl. adjusted parameters for runways
L38: Parking positions, taxiway naming, if data was available
L39: Terminals, towers, facility buildings, fuel stations
L40: Lights
L41: Navigation facilities (ILS, VOR, NDB)
L42: Vegetation
L43: Eye Candy

L314: v2.5
L315: 
L316: (Current)
L317: 
L318: Nov 3, 2023
L319: Este update tem como objetivo melhorar as texturas para os não usuários de Zinertek. Nas outras versões, as texturas do solo ficavam boas para quem tinha o addon, mas percebi que não ficava legal para quem não tinha. Então substituí texturas praticamente no aeroporto inteiro para ficar melhor para ambos. Fiz uma parceria e já estamos desenvolvendo uma versão bem melhor de SBGL, porém continuo atualizando esta aqui para que até lá vocês consigam utilizar o cenario da melhor forma.
L320: Além disso, outras melhorias foram feitas, listadas abaixo: - Melhorias nas texturas do aeroporto inteiro - Correção das marcas de pneus nas pistas 10/15/28 (estava invisível para quem não tinha Zinertek) - Numeração no solo dos gates (gate 23 até 79) - Adição de algumas marcas de sujeira nos gates - Melhoria das árvores próximas a L1 OBS: Em alguns gates, a jetway se conecta na porta traseira da aeronave. Isso é um problema da Asobo, do cenário default, não tem relação com este cenário.
L321: Estamos tentando resolver. ---------- This update aims to improve textures for non-Zinertek users. In other versions, the ground textures were good for those who had the addon, but I realized that it wasn't good for those who didn't have it. So I replaced textures practically in the entire airport to make it better for both. I formed a partnership and we are already developing a much better version of SBGL, but I continue to update this one so that until then you can use the scenario in the best way.
L322: Additionally, other improvements were made, listed below: - Improvements to the textures of the entire airport - Correction of tire marks on tracks 10/15/28 (they were invisible to those who didn't have Zinertek) - Numbering on the ground of the gates (gate 23 to 79) - Added some dirt marks on the gates - Improvement of trees near L1 NOTE: In some gates, the jetway connects to the rear door of the aircraft. This is a problem with Asobo, with the default scenery, it has no relation to this addon.
L323: We are trying to solve it.

L23: 
L24: RAF Mount Pleasant (EGYP) is a Royal Air Force station in the south Atlantic. It is home to between 1,000 and 2,000 British military personnel, it remains the newest purpose-built RAF station. It is home to 1435 Flight, a Eurofighter Typhoon FGR.4 unit.
L25: My aim is to offer a good approximation of RAF Mount Pleasant, and a significant improvement over the autogen, however it's not possible to be super accurate since there is very limited photographic reference material available - I'll strive to make it as good as I can within that scope! Countless hours have gone into this project - so if you like it please take the time to leave a review and rating below.
L26: 
L27: I've made a wide range of improvements over the original autogen airport:
L28:   * Custom models with PBR materials and textures for many buildings, including:
L29:     * Main passenger terminal
L30:     * Large main hangar (thanks to cite20†Vortex SD for helping out and creating this model!)
L31:     * Hardened air shelters
L32:     * Control tower
L33:     * Hospital
L34:     * Fire station
L35:     * Dozens of misc hangars and warehouse buildings
L36:   * Where custom models aren't used, most of the remaining autogen buildings have been replaced with more suitable Asobo models.
L37:   * Replacement apron and taxiway textures, hand-drawn polygons to match satellite imagery materials
L38:   * Replacement of all runways, parking and taxiways.
L39:   * Terraforming everywhere. This has been quite a challenge to avoid any nasty transitions between taxiways while following the undulations of the terrain - drop me a message with details if you find any problems.
L40:   * Static aircraft
L41:   * Improved runway markings, arrestor cables etc, including custom model for RHAG.
L42:   * Added clutter, vehicles and other airfield equipment
L43:   * Added dirt, tyre marks, etc to improve realism
L44:   * Added more painted lines to taxiways, roads, walkways, aircraft parking ramps, using custom painted line textures for improved realism vs the stock lines.

L23: This scenery contains the Mariehamn airport (EFMA) and a couple of important buildings and objects in the city. The city of Mariehamn is the capital of the Åland Islands. Åland is an archipelago province at the entrance to the Gulf of Bothnia in the Baltic Sea, and it is an autonomous territory under Finnish sovereignty. Åland is a demilitarised zone and the only monolingually Swedish-speaking region in Finland.
L24:  From Mariehamn, there is a distance of about 160 kilometers to Turku, a coastal city in mainland Finland, and about the same distance to Stockholm, the capital of Sweden. The Åland islands has two airports – the international airport EFMA in Mariehamn and EFKG on the Kumlinge island in the eastern part of the province.
L25: NOTE! Tested and working as such also in MSFS 2024, except for the slightly changed DEM in this area in the new simulator. To make this airport work correctly in MSFS 2024 you must install the Finland Airport Heightmaps (+DEM) by @Morko addon, available on cite21†https://fsaddons.fi/index.php/useful-add-ons†fsaddons.fi . Also read the NOTE below!
L26: 
L27: MAIN FEATURES
L28:   * Very true to real life
L29:   * Enhanced runway, taxiways and apron areas with the typical Åland-style reddish asphalt
L30:   * Correct taxiway network and taxiway markings and some custom signs
L31:   * Photo-real airport buildings and objects

L23: 
L24: Bucharest Henri Coandă International Airport (LROP) – the largest and busiest airport in Romania, located in Otopeni, approximately 16 km north of Bucharest city center. The airport handles both passenger and cargo traffic and serves as a major hub for Romanian airlines and international flights.
L25: 
L26: * * *
L27: This is my first scenery developed for MSFS 2020, also compatible with MSFS 2024. I have made an effort to recreate the current real-world airport layout and ground infrastructure as accurately as possible, although minor bugs or inaccuracies may still be present.
L28: 
L29: Features:
L30: 
L31:   * Airport layout accurate to the real-world state as of July 2026
L32:   * Compatible with AI traffic
L33:   * Handcrafted models of airport buildings, aprons and taxiways
L34: 
L35: The project is actively developed and further updates are planned.
